title: System Administrator II
description:

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

This role is responsible for the implementation, support, and troubleshooting of server systems, including operating systems, software, compute servers, storage, virtualization, email, Active Directory, and cloud infrastructure. The role has a primary sourcing focus on **AWS experience**, along with Azure, VMware, and other enterprise infrastructure technologies.

**Work Location:** New Delhi

The position follows a five-day workweek. Working hours or days may vary as per work requirements.

Technical Skill Set:

**Cloud Environment AWS (Primary Expertise), Azure and VMware (Mandatory Skillsets)**

Strong hands-on experience with AWS is the primary sourcing preference for this role. Experience with Azure and VMware is also required as part of the broader cloud and infrastructure skill set. Candidates with AWS as their primary cloud platform and additional Azure experience are preferred.

**Servers:** Windows Server 2022, 2016 Datacenter, DNS, DHCP Server, Web Server IIS, SQL Server 2016, VMware, Virtual Server, ESXi Server, Monitoring Server, etc.

**Directory Services:** Active Directory Server 2022 & 2016.

**Web Server:** IIS Server, FTP Server, SMTP Server, etc.

**Mail Server:** Microsoft Exchange Server, Office 365, etc.

**MS Tech:** DNS, DHCP, AD, DC, VPN, Proxy Server, Backup Utilities, Print and File Server.

* In-depth knowledge of server infrastructure, including operating systems, software, compute servers, storage, virtualization, and cloud.
* In-depth knowledge of Active Directory, GPO, DNS, and DHCP.
* In-depth knowledge of Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity Planning and testing.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.
* Ability to provide off-hours support for implementations, upgrades, testing, and troubleshooting.

title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Indeed Job Title

**Conversion UX Strategist – Landing Page Strategy & CRO**

Job Description

We are looking for a strategic thinker who can understand a client’s business, audience, product or service, and campaign objectives, then independently develop a complete landing-page strategy focused on conversions.

This is **not a website design or development role**. The primary responsibility is research, conversion planning, content structure, messaging strategy, and presenting a clear plan for client approval before design begins.

You should be able to start with a business objective and build the landing-page journey from scratch—without relying on a ready-made layout, predefined section list, or design reference.

What You’ll Do

**1. Business & Audience Research**

* Understand the client’s business model, products or services, target audience, and campaign objectives.
* Research competitors, customer intent, audience pain points, and reasons prospects may hesitate to convert.
* Identify the key information and value propositions needed to persuade the intended audience.
* Translate business goals into a clear landing-page conversion strategy.

**2. Landing-Page Journey Planning**

* Plan the complete visitor journey, from the first screen to the final call to action.
* Decide the appropriate section structure and information hierarchy based on the campaign goal.
* Determine what visitors need to understand, believe, and see before taking action.
* Define the messaging flow, CTA placement, trust elements, and supporting information.
* Develop the page structure independently rather than waiting for a predefined layout or section list.

**3. Content Strategy & Information Gathering**

* Define the purpose and required content of every section.
* Identify missing business information, proof points, case studies, testimonials, and other assets needed to build a persuasive page.
* Prepare focused questions for clients to gather the information required for the strategy.
* Recommend messaging directions that communicate the client’s value clearly and address customer objections.

**4. Conversion Strategy & Decision-Making**

* Explain the reasoning behind each recommended section and its placement.
* Ensure that the page structure supports the campaign objective and intended conversion action.
* Identify potential friction points that could prevent visitors from enquiring or taking the desired action.
* Recommend relevant trust signals, credibility elements, and calls to action based on audience needs.
* Make strategic decisions independently and justify them using customer intent and conversion principles.

**5. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval**

* Prepare a structured Google Doc for client review and approval before design begins.
* Document the business context, campaign objective, target audience, and primary conversion goal.
* Outline the recommended page journey and section-by-section structure.
* Explain the purpose, content requirements, and information hierarchy of each section.
* Document messaging direction, CTA strategy, trust elements, and credibility requirements.
* List missing information and questions that need client input.
* Present the reasoning behind the overall page strategy in clear, professional language.
* Incorporate client feedback and finalize the plan for approval.

**6. Design Handoff**

* Hand over the approved strategy document for page creation using AI design tools.
* Ensure the resulting page follows the approved structure, messaging direction, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with the design or delivery team to clarify strategic decisions when needed.

Role Requirements

* Strong research, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving.
* Ability to turn business goals and customer insights into a persuasive page journey.
* Clear writing and content-structuring skills.
* Confidence in explaining and defending strategic recommendations.
* Ability to identify missing information and ask clients the right questions.
* Comfort working independently without ready-made templates or detailed instructions.

Experience

Experience in landing-page strategy, conversion rate optimization (CRO), UX strategy, copywriting, digital marketing strategy, or related work is preferred. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how they approach a business problem and develop a conversion-focused page structure from scratch.

Who Can Apply

* Candidates with experience in UX strategy, CRO, landing-page planning, or conversion-focused copywriting.
* Digital marketing strategists who understand campaign goals, audience intent, and lead generation.
* Strong researchers and writers who can independently structure information and build a persuasive customer journey.
* Candidates who can present strategic recommendations clearly to clients.

Skills

* Business and audience research.
* Landing-page journey planning and information architecture.
* Conversion rate optimization principles.
* Content strategy and messaging hierarchy.
* CTA planning and objection handling.
* Trust-building and credibility strategy.
* Competitor and customer-intent analysis.
* Client communication and presentation.
* Structured documentation using Google Docs.
* Critical thinking, independent decision-making, and clear written communication.

**Important:** This role is about deciding what the landing page should communicate, how it should be structured, and why each section matters. Design skills alone are not sufficient; the ability to develop and explain a conversion strategy independently is essential.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Placement Manager** to manage placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and various Skill Development Programs**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with employers, identifying suitable job opportunities, organizing recruitment drives and interviews, and ensuring successful placement of trained candidates in relevant industries and job roles.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **skill development and placement ecosystem**, excellent employer networking skills, and a proven ability to achieve placement targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and Skill Development Projects**.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with companies, employers, HR departments, recruiters and industry partners.
* Identify suitable employment opportunities based on candidates' **skills, qualifications, training and job profiles**.
* Generate new employer tie-ups and placement opportunities across relevant industries.
* Collect and understand employer manpower requirements and coordinate recruitment accordingly.
* Organize **job fairs, recruitment drives, walk-in interviews, campus interviews and employer selection processes**.
* Coordinate candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, documentation and joining formalities.
* Ensure maximum conversion of trained candidates into **successful placements and joining**.
* Maintain regular communication with placed candidates and employers for joining and retention tracking.
* Track placement data, joining status, salary details, employer details and candidate retention.
* Prepare MIS reports, placement reports and project-related documentation within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with Training Centre, Mobilization, MIS and Project teams to achieve overall project placement targets.
* Ensure placement activities are aligned with **DDU-GKY and applicable Skill Development Project guidelines/SOPs**.
* Conduct regular market research to identify new employment sectors, job roles and salary opportunities.
* Build a strong employer database and continuously expand the placement network.
* Support the organization in achieving project-wise placement, joining and retention targets.
* Handle employer and candidate grievances related to the placement process.

Required Skills

* Strong **Employer Relationship Management** skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong networking and business development abilities.
* Good knowledge of **placement processes and recruitment practices**.
* Understanding of **DDU-GKY / Skill Development / Government-funded skilling projects**.
* Ability to generate new placement opportunities and employer tie-ups.
* Strong follow-up and target-oriented approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Email and MIS reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and placement targets simultaneously.
* Strong team management and coordination skills.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* DDU-GKY / DDU-GKY 2.0 Projects
* Skill Development Projects
* Government Skill Development Programs
* Placement-linked training projects
* Training & Placement organizations
* NSDC / State Skill Mission / PMKVY-related projects
* Recruitment / Staffing / Manpower Industry
* Corporate HR / Employer Relations
* Job Fairs and Campus Recruitment

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of employer tie-ups generated
* Number of job opportunities generated
* Candidate interview and selection ratio
* Placement and joining percentage
* Average salary offered to candidates
* Candidate retention/continuation after joining
* Employer satisfaction
* Timely and accurate MIS/project reporting
* Achievement of project-wise placement targets

Education

**Bachelor's Degree** in any discipline is required.

MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing, Business Development or a related field will be an added advantage.

Salary

**₹25,000 – ₹50,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and project requirements.

**Performance-based incentives** may be provided for achieving placement and employer engagement targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a **target-oriented, proactive and well-connected placement professional** who can independently develop employer networks and convert trained candidates into meaningful employment opportunities.

description:
Job Description – LMS Executive / LMS Administrator

**Position:** LMS Executive / LMS Administrator  
**Experience Required:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Learning Management System / Academic Operations

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **LMS Executive / LMS Administrator** who can independently manage the end\-to\-end operations of a Learning Management System. The candidate should have practical experience in course creation, user management, enrolment, activity configuration, content management, reporting, troubleshooting, and learner support.

The ideal candidate should also have working knowledge of **H5P, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom**, along with strong communication and coordination skills.

Key Responsibilities

* **LMS Administration**
* Manage day\-to\-day LMS operations and ensure smooth functioning of the platform.
* Create, configure, update, and maintain courses within the LMS.
* Manage course categories, sections, modules, and learning paths.
* Configure course completion and activity completion criteria.
* Maintain proper course structure and ensure content is organized correctly.
* **User Management \& Enrolment**
* Create and manage learner, faculty, trainer, and administrator accounts.
* Enrol users into appropriate courses and programs.
* Assign courses according to learner requirements.
* Manage bulk user creation and enrolment through CSV/Excel files.
* Handle user roles, permissions, cohorts, groups, and access settings.
* Resolve login, enrolment, password, and course\-access\-related issues.
* **Course \& Activity Management**
* Add and configure different LMS activities and resources such as:
* Assignments
* Quizzes
* Forums
* Feedback forms
* Surveys
* Certificates
* Videos
* PDFs
* URLs
* SCORM packages
* H5P interactive content
* Configure restrictions, deadlines, grading, completion tracking, and activity availability.
* **H5P Content Management**
* Create and manage interactive learning content using **H5P**.
* Develop interactive videos, presentations, quizzes, drag\-and\-drop activities, flashcards, and other H5P activities.
* Test H5P activities for proper functionality and learner experience.
* Integrate H5P activities into LMS courses.
* **Live Class Management**
* Create and manage online classes through **Zoom and Microsoft Teams**.
* Schedule live sessions and share meeting links with learners and faculty.
* Manage meeting settings, participant access, recordings, and related configurations.
* Coordinate with faculty/trainers for smooth delivery of live sessions.
* Upload or link recorded sessions within the LMS wherever required.
* **LMS Content Management**
* Upload and organize course materials such as presentations, documents, videos, assignments, and learning resources.
* Ensure learning content is correctly mapped with the respective courses and modules.
* Update existing course content whenever required.
* Perform regular checks to ensure links, activities, videos, and resources are working properly.
* **Excel \& Data Management**
* Should have good working knowledge of **Microsoft Excel**.
* Maintain learner, course, enrolment, attendance, and completion data.
* Work with large datasets for bulk LMS operations.
* Should be comfortable with:
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
* Pivot Tables
* Filters and Sorting
* Conditional Formatting
* Data Validation
* Basic formulas and data cleaning
* Prepare LMS reports and management reports as required.
* **Reporting \& Tracking**
* Monitor learner progress and course completion.
* Generate reports related to enrolment, attendance, activity completion, assessments, and certifications.
* Track incomplete activities and learner participation.
* Provide required LMS data and reports to internal teams and management.
* **Troubleshooting \& Support**
* Provide first\-level support for LMS\-related issues.
* Troubleshoot issues related to:
* User login
* Course access
* Enrolment
* Activities
* Assessments
* Certificates
* SCORM
* H5P
* Live class links
* Course completion
* Coordinate with technical teams for issues requiring backend or server\-level support.
* **Communication \& Coordination**
* Communicate professionally with learners, faculty, trainers, clients, and internal teams.
* Coordinate with faculty for course content, live classes, assignments, and activities.
* Handle learner queries through calls, emails, chat, or other communication channels.
* Maintain proper records of LMS\-related requests and resolutions.

Required Skills

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in **LMS Administration / LMS Operations / E\-Learning Operations**.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end LMS functionality.
* Hands\-on experience in course creation and course management.
* Experience in user creation, bulk enrolment, course assignment, and user management.
* Good understanding of LMS activities, assessments, completion criteria, and reporting.
* Knowledge of **H5P interactive content creation**.
* Understanding of **SCORM packages and e\-learning content**.
* Good knowledge of **Microsoft Excel**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft Teams and Zoom**.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple courses, users, and tasks simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, faculty, clients, and learners.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with **Moodle or similar Learning Management Systems**.
* Knowledge of LMS roles, permissions, groups, cohorts, and course categories.
* Experience managing certificates and course completion workflows.
* Basic understanding of LMS integrations and plugins.
* Experience with SCORM and interactive e\-learning content.
* Understanding of online assessment and quiz configuration.
* Experience handling LMS data for a large number of users.
* Basic knowledge of HTML or content formatting would be an advantage.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s degree in any relevant discipline.
* Candidates with qualifications in IT, Computer Applications, Education Technology, Learning \& Development, or related fields will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be someone who can independently manage **end\-to\-end LMS operations**, from creating a user and enrolling them into a course to configuring activities, tracking progress, generating reports, supporting live sessions, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring a smooth learning experience for users.

The candidate should be technically comfortable with LMS platforms while also having strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively with learners, faculty, clients, and internal teams.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further


International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.


We are currently seeking an experienced person to join the WPB Premier Services Team

**Role Purpose**

* The HSBC Premier offering is one of the world’s first globally linked banking offerings. And of strategic importance for HSBC, the role requires you to be part of premier relationship team across branches
* The role provides dedicated support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRM) in the overall achievement of their income plans (covering acquisition, cross sales, retention, and growth of their portfolios) and day to day contact with their clients in the delivery of the proposition objectives
* In order to deliver client centric service the role also requires you to be a point of contact for clients as and when required and provide customer with a memorable service experience by having a problem solving attitude


In addition, the Premier Officer may provide credit/lending support to the PRM if dictated by market requirements. Building an ongoing relationship based on value and service is critical to being successful in this role.


In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to demonstrate an extensive knowledge of banking products and services across wealth and retail.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Impact on the business**

* Provide high quality sales support to a team of PRMs mainly focused on getting appointment for PRMs and supporting PRMs in servicing their clients
* Reduce the time spent on process and administrative tasks by PRM to increase PRM’s capacity
* Support PRMs to manage client contact and service, including, in the absence of PRMs, answering client calls, resolving client enquiries on transactional needs and facilitating a smooth hand\-off to the correct channels where appropriate, and managing key event reminders to maintain active client contact
* Provide sales support to PRMs including preparing and completing sales documents, managing data input and report generation, and liaising with support functions to follow through client purchase process requirement

**Clients/Stakeholders**

* Handle client’s enquiries relating to the PRM’s portfolio in a positive, timely, and appropriate manner. Aim to resolve the customer’s queries at the first point of contact and minimise referrals to the PRM for routine transactions.
* Has strong knowledge of the PRM’s portfolio of clients with the support of CRMS and analytical tools
* Proactively responds to client in face\-to\-face and/or telephone settings, updating client profile screens with details of client contact
* Maintains a basic understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services
* Support PRMs to execute suitable solutions for product areas responsible for with clients to fulfill their needs and ensure efficient follow up
* Manager the Premier desk (including required contact activity) in the absence of PRM.
* Assist the PRM in organizing events as and when required.
* Refer the attrition cases to PRM immediately
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to manage Premier TAT / customer expectations

**Leadership and teamwork**

* Communicate effectively and works well with other teams within the Branch, Call Center, HTS, and other relevant partners that impact the client’s experience of HSBC; in order to ensure a consistent approach and application of Premier standards
* Efficiently manages time in order to support different PRMs concurrently
* Proactively identifies opportunities/issues and provides feedback to branch management and HTS to improve products and service processes
* Delivering the firm \- Put the client at the heart of our business and deliver joined up services and solutions aligned to customer needs.

**Operational effectiveness and control**

* Ensure all processes and procedures are accurate and in accordance with HSBC Bank policy standards, regulatory requirements, Group Compliance Policy and Internal Controls.
* Comply with local regulations in all aspects of strategy, sales processes, client correspondence, financial promotions, administration, and complaint handling
* Zero discrepancies on documentation for new Liability \& Wealth accounts.
* Ensure 100% accuracy on all KYC and Non KYC documentation and processing of customer instructions
* Ensure all entries captured on WMS are error free and that the entries are reconciled everyday.
* Achieve the operational standards for the business and work within agreed procedures and guidelines \- displaying high levels of integrity at all times
* Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section B.1\.2 of the Group Operations FIM.
* Minimum concurrent audit comments and NIL reminders
* Ensure NIL frauds for any cases sourced /handled by the branch.
* Ensure use of RMP for activity management and referring leads to PRMs
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD \& EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML \& Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non\-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**

* Provide high quality support to PRMs
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures in order to handle client needs
* Proactively help HSBC identify opportunity to improve process efficiencies
* Sensitively redirect clients to the most effective and efficient channel
* Support the client in navigating the channel of their choice (to interact with HSBC) effectively and efficiently
* Ensure the client consistently receives a professional premium service which exceeds their expectations at all times
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations
* Ensuring the highest standards of customer service in terms of timeliness and customer experience.
* Enhancing customer confidence in the bank’s Global Premier proposition by ensuring the offer of a relevant product suite and supporting this through systematic and regular communication is a key aspect of the role.
* given the growth aspirations of the WM business, the jobholder is to constantly source, develop and grow Premier relationships in a highly competitive market. title: Loss Prevention Executive
description:
Loss Prevention Associate

**Mail: hr@rareplanet.com**

* Location: Ghitorni, New Delhi \- Full\-time – Onsite
* Timing: 09\.00 am to 06\.00 pm
* Working: 6 Days a Week ( Monday to Saturday)
* Preference: Retail

Loss prevention has numerous duties and responsibilities that are crucial for preventing the company from losing money and merchandise, while also ensuring a safe shopping experience.

* **The following are major duties and responsibilities of a Loss Prevention Officer:**
* 1\. Monitor for unusual activity at retail stores
* 2\. Monitor security systems, like alarms and closed\-circuit cameras, to ensure they are working properly and in alignment for getting correct Visuals, including internet, router, etc
* 3\. Identify potential thieves from customers or staff.
* 4\. Follow and confront a potential person of interest who is suspected of shoplifting.
* 5\. Document theft and other violations of security, and what they observed on duty.
* 6\. Work with law enforcement to detain suspects of shoplifting or dishonest employees.
* 7\. In retail stores, loss prevention protects people, money, equipment, and merchandise.
* 8\. Undercover store detectives to prevent theft.
* 9\. Count walk\-in customers / Conversion Ratio to sales invoices
* 10\. Record / Picture unusual activities

**Retail Store Operations:**

* 1\. See that retail store staff do not use mobile/s during retail sales hours or at the store
* 2\. Ensure that retail store staff are present at the store on time as per the roster with specified uniform and grooming standards.
* 3\. Count Customer Walk\-ins and generate a conversion ratio to inform the store in charge to increase the conversion ratio regularly
* 4\. Identify and report suspicious activities or policy violations.
* 5\. Coordinate with Store Managers and Area Managers on inventory discrepancies.
* 6\. Investigate incidents and prepare factual reports with preventive action plans.
* 7\. Support training and awareness sessions for store teams on loss prevention.
* 8\. Strong observation, investigation, and reporting skills.
* 9\. Ability to handle confidential information with integrity.
* 10\. Maintain data of the above and inform the HR/reporting manager for penalties, which have to be reported in the concerned group within 24 hours of the incident.

**Inventory:**

* 1\. Conduct regular audits of stock and cash handling processes.
* 2\. Mandatory to implement a monthly physical audit, identify differences and make reports to cut down variances every month
* 3\. Monitor store operations to prevent stock shrinkage, theft, and pilferage.
* 4\. Monitor Damages / Shortages and inform the store manager / in charge
* 5\. Charge Penalties from time to time, giving notice along with proof within 24 hours of the activity

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
